Both Kanamycin and Cefazolin are indicated for Cholangitis, with Kanamycin also linked to Igg4-related Sclerosing Cholangitis. This implies that Kanamycin may influence the progression of Cholangitis, potentially through the same mechanisms that affect Cefazolin. The final scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the evidence is not definitive. The pathways suggest a possible role of these antibiotics in the development or progression of suppurative cholangitis, though further research is needed to establish a causal link. The integration of these findings highlights the importance of considering antibiotic indications and their associated conditions in the context of disease progression.
